description: This Java source file defines the CompileTool class, which provides functionality to process a script-like input file, convert its expressions to Reverse Polish Notation (RPN), and generate a corresponding output file with macro definitions. The class includes a method to run the process, handle individual lines, and interface with external libraries for expression evaluation.

classes.name: CompileTool
classes.description: A utility class that reads an input file line by line, processes expressions into RPN, and writes out macro definitions to an output file. It also logs processing steps to the console.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method that takes a list of arguments specifying input and output file names, reads the input, processes each line to convert expressions, and writes the results to the output file.

methods.name: handleOneFsioLine
methods.description: Processes a single line from the input file, converting expressions to RPN and generating macro definitions. Handles comment lines and errors.
